repair_output.objective: Determine evidence-linked identity and potency framework required before comparing SGL-001 lots or formulations and advancing intranasal bridging studies.
repair_output.proposed_next_action: Assemble a Stage-1 CMC/analytics package and supply the following evidence for review: (1) MCB/WCB characterization and certificates; (2) manufacturing records and comparability reports for  GMP-like batches; (3) definitions and validated reports for an orthogonal QC panel and intact-EV assays (fit-for-purpose validation metrics: LLOQ, specificity, precision); (4) stability-indicating potency assay validation and linkage to an in vivo PD endpoint; (5) formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact-EV recovery. Request an expedited evidence review once these items are available and plan regulator briefing per program timeline. If these items cannot be produced, document limitations explicitly and consider targeted method-development milestones before large-animal bridging studies.

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: Supported: MISEV2023 establishes the need for transparent, orthogonal characterization, release criteria, and mechanism-linked potency assays prior to advancing formulations. However, program-specific CMC evidence (MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV assays, batch comparability, stability-indicating potency assay) is not present in the supplied evidence set, so the program has not yet demonstrated readiness for bridging or lot-comparison work.
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC data (MCB/WCB documentation, orthogonal QC panel definitions and validation reports, stability and release results across  GMP-like runs, potency assay validation and correlation to in vivo PD).
limitations: Only the MISEV2023 guideline is available as supplied evidence; no program-specific CMC documents (MCB/WCB records, validation protocols/reports, batch release data, stability studies) are provided.
Several claims in the record cite additional empirical studies (rodent/large-animal biodistribution) that are not available in the allowed evidence for this review.
requested_evidence: Master Cell Bank (MCB) / Working Cell Bank (WCB) characterization reports and certificates
Detailed manufacturing scale-up and comparability reports for  GMP-like batches (process descriptions, in-process controls, release specifications, outcomes)
Validation reports for orthogonal identity/purity assays (particle count, protein markers, lipid markers, separation metrics) including LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy
Validation report for an intact-EV assay demonstrating it measures vesicle-associated signal (method, fit-for-purpose validation)
Stability studies with stability-indicating potency assay results and specification limits
Correlation data linking potency assay to a relevant in vivo PD endpoint (or prespecified surrogate)

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: Supported but evidence-limited: The MISEV2023 consensus supports requiring orthogonal characterization and controlled production reporting to mitigate risks from non-vesicular contaminants and process variability. The program currently lacks supplied manufacturing evidence to show reproducible, scalable production suitable for advancing an intranasal formulation.
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Manufacturing run records, scale-up comparability reports, device/formulation compatibility studies showing intact-EV recovery after formulation and dosing (ex vivo and in vivo).
limitations: No batch production records, process validation, or scale-up comparability data were provided in the allowed evidence set.
Rodent vs large-animal biodistribution claims reference other studies not included here; therefore we cannot evaluate translatability empirically from the supplied evidence.
requested_evidence: Three representative GMP-like batch manufacturing records and release data
Comparability assessment reports across scale-up (analytical side-by-side for identity, purity, potency)
Formulation and device compatibility studies assessing intact-EV recovery and integrity after filling/delivery (bench and ex vivo)
Raw analytical data for assays used to demonstrate lot-to-lot consistency

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: The supplied evidence set contains only the MISEV2023 consensus guideline and does not provide program-specific primary experimental or QA/QC data needed to support or refute claims about SGL-001 materials' compliance with CMC/analytics requirements or cross-species biodistribution. Consequently, program-specific assertions regarding meeting or failing CMC requirements cannot be endorsed from the available evidence.
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Primary experimental and QA/QC evidence from the program and from cross-species biodistribution studies with orthogonal intact-EV assays are missing; without those, the program-specific claims cannot be adjudicated.
limitations: Only a consensus guideline is available; no primary experimental or CMC documentation from SGL-001 was provided in this evidence set.
Claims that cite non-supplied primary studies cannot be verified here.
requested_evidence: Primary reports for any rodent and large-animal intranasal biodistribution studies including methods that distinguish intact EV from free cargo/non-vesicular signal
Analytical validation reports for intact-EV detection assays used in those studies
Release specifications and raw data demonstrating lot-to-lot analytic comparability

repair_output.strongest_contradiction_summary: No contradiction is present in the supplied evidence set. Program-specific assertions that materials either do or do not demonstrate characterized MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV assays, or scalable reproducible production cannot be confirmed or contradicted because those program documents are not provided.
repair_output.strongest_support_summary: MISEV2023 consensus guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) explicitly recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, and appropriate functional/production reporting to de-risk identity and potency claims and support in vivo interpretation.
